result.summary: The street features narrow sidewalks on both sides with no physical buffer from the roadway. Pedestrian movement is hindered by utility poles located within the walkway and a lack of marked crossing infrastructure.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are placed directly in the path of the sidewalk on the left, forcing pedestrians to maneuver around them.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: There is no separation between the narrow sidewalk and the travel lane, increasing risk from passing vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk and relocate utility poles to provide a clear, ADA-compliant walking path.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks at intersections or mid-block to provide designated crossing points.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees to create a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and traffic.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban street with a continuous paved sidewalk directly adjacent to the roadway. The environment features buildings at the sidewalk edge, including a residence and a church, but lacks any physical buffer or greenery between pedestrians and the travel lane.

hazards.name: Trip hazard
hazards.description: A small raised concrete platform or step is located directly on the sidewalk path in front of the residential building.
hazards.location_in_image: Lower left foreground on the sidewalk

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation or furniture zone between the walking area and the active roadway.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install street trees or large planters to create a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway to eliminate cracks and uneven surfaces that can affect vehicle control and pedestrian crossing.

result.summary: The image shows a four-way intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and stop-sign control for the cross-street. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present on all corners, the environment lacks advanced pedestrian protections such as curb extensions or dedicated pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction (Daylighting)
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the image are positioned very close to the crosswalk, potentially obscuring pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground and mid-ground near the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection relies solely on stop signs and paint, with no active signals to indicate when it is safe for pedestrians to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Signage
interventions.description: Install pedestrian crossing warning signs to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, paved sidewalk in good condition adjacent to a large stone institutional building. A chain-link fence separates the walkway from the building, while parallel parked cars and a small street tree are located along the curb.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large SUV parked at the curb blocks sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and vehicles in the roadway.

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The long stone wall and chain-link fence provide no active engagement or natural surveillance of the street environment.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and personal security for pedestrians using the walkway at night.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at nearby intersections to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce crossing distances.
